claim: Default translation engine in translate.py is libretranslate when --engine is not set and no env var selects an engine
sub_question: What is the default translation backend in translate.py when no env var is set?
evidence: CLI --engine defaults to libretranslate; translate_text and cmd_text also default engine to libretranslate. Module docs call LibreTranslate the default remote backend. No env var selects the translation engine (only D_RESEARCH_ALLOW_REMOTE_TRANSLATION gates remote opt-in).
notes: Cross-checked function signature engine: str = "libretranslate" and getattr(args, "engine", "libretranslate").
